adjudication.depicted_input: Figure 6 directly depicts the prompt interfaces for unconditional cell generation, conditional cell generation, and cell type prediction, including the ranked-gene cell sentence and prompt-plus-label forms that are supplied to the model.
adjudication.rationale: The rejection rationale is too strict. Atlas rules allow a shared figure to support multiple named variants from the same paper when they use the same depicted input mechanism, and the exact variant name need not appear in the crop. Figure 6 is the paper’s dedicated prompt figure and visibly shows the actual model-input forms for all listed routes: a directive prompt for unconditional generation, a prompt plus cell-type label for conditional generation, and a prompt plus cell sentence for cell-type prediction. Because the current crop already cleanly contains those three route-specific input interfaces, no adjustment or replacement is needed.
